terminals.name: qq-music-api
terminals.command: cd qq-music-xiaozhi && QQ_MUSIC_API_CONFIG_DIR=./config USE_GLOBAL_COOKIE=true PORT=3200 node ./node_modules/@sansenjian/qq-music-api/dist/app.js
terminals.description: QQ Music HTTP API on http://localhost:3200 (e.g. /getRanks, /getTopLists, /getSearchByKey).

terminals.name: music-proxy
terminals.command: cd qq-music-xiaozhi && QQ_MUSIC_API_CONFIG_DIR=./config USE_GLOBAL_COOKIE=true MUSIC_PROXY_HOST=127.0.0.1 MUSIC_PROXY_PORT=3210 node ./mcp/proxy-play.mjs
terminals.description: Music reverse proxy on http://localhost:3210 (MP3 -> PCM via ffmpeg; /health, /proxy/pcm, /proxy/play).

terminals.name: xiaozhi-mcp-pipe
terminals.command: cd qq-music-xiaozhi && if [ -n "${MCP_ENDPOINT:-}" ] && ! printf '%s' "$MCP_ENDPOINT" | grep -q '请替换'; then MUSIC_PROXY_HOST=127.0.0.1 MUSIC_PROXY_PORT=3210 ./.venv/bin/python mcp/mcp_pipe.py; else echo '[xiaozhi-mcp-pipe] MCP_ENDPOINT not set. Add it as a secret (wss://api.xiaozhi.me/mcp/?token=...) to bridge the local MCP to xiaozhi.me. Staying idle.'; sleep infinity; fi
terminals.description: Bridges the local QQ Music MCP to the Xiaozhi cloud. Needs the MCP_ENDPOINT secret; idle without it.
